title: Escape Velocity: 11.2 km/s
description: Season 2 Episode 3: Escape velocity is the speed at which a thrown object never comes back — and it explains why the Moon has no air.
exam_focus: JEE/NEET: escape speed formula, why Moon has no atmosphere (classic NCERT exercise)
topic: Escape Velocity & Why Moon Has No Air
golden_rule: v_rms > v_escape : MOON HAS NO AIR
takeaway: Earth holds its air (11.2 km/s) · Moon lost its air (2.4 km/s)
teaser_question: JANUARY SHOCK: Earth Sun ke sabse paas kab hoti hai?
concept: Escape velocity is the speed at which a thrown object never comes back — and it explains why the Moon has no air.
on_screen_cues: "11.2 km/s = 40,000 km/h" → "Moon: 2.4 km/s" → "Gas molecules > escape speed → bye bye atmosphere" → "vₑ = √(2gR) · NCERT XI Ch 7"
pinned_comment: Jupiter ki escape velocity guess karo 👇 (Answer pinned next week)" — answer ≈ 60 km/s.
suggested_titles: "Escape Velocity kya hai? Aur Moon pe hawa kyun nahi" / "11.2 km/s — Earth chhodne ki speed"
elevenlabs_script:
Gudiya: [curious] Chintu, Earth ko hamesha ke liye chhodne ke liye kitni speed chahiye?
Chintu: [excited] 11 point 2 kilometre... per SECOND!
Gudiya: [gasps] Per second?! Matlab?
Chintu: [dramatic tone] Dilli se Mumbai... 2 minute se kam mein.
Gudiya: [surprised] Whaaat?! Isko kya bolte hain?
Chintu: [excited] ESCAPE VELOCITY! Is speed pe cheez upar jaake wapas nahi aati. Kabhi nahi.
Gudiya: [thoughtful] Aur Moon pe?
Chintu: [cheerfully] Sirf 2 point 4 kilometre per second. Moon chhota hai, gravity kam hai.
Gudiya: [curious] Toh isse kya farak padta hai?
Chintu: [mischievously] Yaad hai Venus ki atmosphere? Moon ke paas hawa kyun nahi hai, socha kabhi?
Gudiya: [confused] Kyun nahi hai?
Chintu: [excited] Gas ke molecules bahut tez bhaagte hain! Moon ki escape velocity itni kam hai ki garmi mein woh molecules space mein bhaag gaye!
Gudiya: [elated] Matlab Moon ki hawa... escape kar gayi?! Literally?!
Chintu: [laughs] Literally! Aur Earth ki gravity ne hamari hawa ko pakad ke rakha hai!
Gudiya: [curious] Toh Earth Sun ke chakkar mein kaisi ghoomti hai?
Chintu: [mischievously] Woh next video mein! Aur usme ek shock hai... January wala.
